scope: Curated source-checked research batch; NOT a complete census of reporting or posts
notes: Every item has a source URL and its publisher's publication date; dates are not necessarily event dates.
Counts show only items captured in this research batch, not relative political activity or media attention.
X post permalinks were recovered from publisher embeds. They may require a login or be inaccessible via crawlers; source page corroborates link.
No individually verifiable historic Meta or LinkedIn post URL has been recovered in this batch; public account and issue-search links are discovery only.
When an issue/leader filter returns no records, that means not yet captured, not that no reporting or posts exist.
Allegations, proposed schemes and projected outcomes must not be represented as established wrongdoing or completed results.
Original research batch now augmented with date-checked reporting across all six leaders; some stories about the same event from different publishers are separate source entries.

Additional exact X status permalinks were recovered from HTML embeds on the public publisher pages. Tweet creation dates verified using X snowflake IDs; headlines are sourced from surrounding publisher reports and are not represented as verbatim original post text.

records.title: Farmer support and power-supply commitments
records.summary: Yadav described farmer-welfare priorities and announced daytime agricultural electricity and horticulture support; these are reported commitments, not independently measured outcomes.

records.title: Mineral auction amid land-acquisition objections
records.summary: Yadav said a contested mineral auction would not advance until the administration and he were satisfied; opposition from affected people was reported.

records.title: Cabinet extends irrigation and public schemes
records.summary: The cabinet chaired by Yadav approved/extended measures involving irrigation and public-service schemes; the article reports projected programme spending.

records.title: Tribal historical figures in curricula
records.summary: Yadav spoke in Jabalpur about including tribal leaders in curriculum and producing films on tribal historical figures.

records.title: Mandla district development-project events
records.summary: Yadav inaugurated or initiated 74 reported development works with headline value above ₹460 crore; verify actual completion separately.

records.title: Agriculture-department promotion and recruitment directions
records.summary: Yadav directed regular departmental promotion processes and referred to recruitment targets. Targets and claims are not outcome verification.

records.title: Officer suspended over alleged abuse of tribal students
records.summary: Police suspended a Bhopal officer after allegations concerning 'Jai Johar' student demonstrators; this record is state-government context, not a personal order by Yadav.

records.title: Navratri visit to Ujjain Kali temple
records.summary: Yadav offered prayers during Navratri; a newspaper embedded a direct X post from his account.

records.title: Police Commemoration Day welfare announcement
records.summary: Yadav announced an assistance allocation for families of police personnel killed in duty and claimed progress in counter-Maoist operations; claims attributed.

records.title: Dhar micro-irrigation project and crop-insurance transfer
records.summary: Yadav inaugurated a ₹2,387.60 crore irrigation project and reported transfers of ₹317.86 crore in crop-insurance support.

records.title: Medicinal-plant research institute proposed in Barwani
records.summary: Yadav announced an institute for conservation and research of forest medicinal plants; not evidence of institute completion.

records.title: Baglamukhi Devi Lok project foundation
records.summary: Yadav conducted the ceremonial initiation of a proposed religious-site development project; construction status is not confirmed.

records.title: Urban affordable-housing and recycled-water drafts
records.summary: Officials described policy drafts to be presented at an Indore conclave attended by Yadav; this is a preview of proposals, not verified implementation.

records.title: Balaghat tribal health concerns raised
records.summary: The opposition leader's dated public video describes a meeting with families concerning tribal-area health, water and nutrition services.

records.title: Indore contaminated-water inquiry demanded
records.summary: Singhar demanded publication of an inquiry report and questioned accountability of elected representatives; reported claims remain attributed.

records.title: Dhar police-outpost inspection
records.summary: Singhar visited a police outpost and questioned staffing after reporting an absence of personnel.

records.title: Contaminated-water response questioned
records.summary: Singhar criticised the handling of Indore's Bhagirathpura water case and sought accountability.

records.title: FIR demanded after 'Jai Johar' protest incident
records.summary: Singhar demanded action over alleged treatment of tribal students by a police officer, citing tribal identity and constitutional rights.

records.title: Purchasing-price discrepancies alleged
records.summary: Singhar alleged excess costs in local-body and MLA-fund purchases and called for a neutral inquiry; wrongdoing is not established by the report.

records.title: Visited families opposing proposed Rewa nuclear plant
records.summary: Singhar visited Rohjauhi amid resistance to a proposed nuclear power project, following the death of a tribal protester.

records.title: Gram Sabha consent and Ken-Betwa displacement questions
records.summary: Singhar said project-affected communities had not been adequately consulted and pledged to raise the dispute in the Assembly; assertions attributed.

records.title: Sanitation workers' minimum pay and regularisation
records.summary: Singhar wrote to the CM demanding minimum ₹25,000 monthly pay and employment regularisation for sanitation workers.

records.title: Odisha investment outreach to UAE
records.summary: Majhi attended investor outreach aimed at industrial diversification; announced proposals are not completed investments.

records.title: Urban cleanliness campaign in Bhubaneswar
records.summary: Majhi participated in a civic cleanliness event and called for public engagement in sanitation.

records.title: Ground-rent waiver for festival organisers
records.summary: Majhi waived specified municipal ground rent for multiple religious and cultural festivals in Bhubaneswar.

records.title: Proposed state social-media policy and fact-check system
records.summary: Majhi announced plans for a social-media policy and government communication system; proposals, not deployed services.

records.title: Puri heritage-site development review
records.summary: Majhi reviewed Puri temple-area and tourism infrastructure and instructed officials to address delays.

records.title: Industrial projects with projected job creation
records.summary: Sambad reports that Majhi inaugurated and laid the foundations of 53 industrial projects worth ₹39,383 crore; 42,512 jobs are projected, not verified realised employment.

records.title: Maha Navami greetings
records.summary: Prameya embedded Majhi's own X post containing religious-festival greetings.

records.title: Anti-corruption enforcement approach described
records.summary: Majhi described the government's vigilance strategy and cited a conviction-rate figure that needs administrative data confirmation.

records.title: Disaster preparedness reaffirmed
records.summary: On Odisha Disaster Preparedness Day, Majhi stated the government's commitment to disaster-risk reduction.

records.title: Compensation promised for flood-affected farmers
records.summary: Majhi said compensation would follow crop-loss surveys according to applicable rules; payments not independently confirmed.

records.title: Mineral-rights amendment opposed
records.summary: Patnaik argued that the 2026 mining legislation could reduce states' fiscal autonomy; claims and legal interpretation attributed.

records.title: Minerals-law campaign and all-party meeting request
records.summary: Patnaik sought broader opposition to amended mining law and appealed for an all-party meeting and Assembly session.

records.title: Small traders' interests in proposed UPI charges
records.summary: Patnaik urged protection for shopkeepers amid debate over merchant-payment charges; proposal subject to separate verification.

records.title: BJD rally against mineral taxation changes
records.summary: Patnaik led a rally against the amended MMDR Act; policy criticism and fiscal-loss assertions remain attributed.

records.title: Public welfare and prices criticised
records.summary: At a BJD outreach event Patnaik criticised the government over costs and social welfare; evaluative claims remain attributed.

records.title: Student-union elections commented upon
records.summary: Patnaik congratulated participants and alleged unfair election practices; electoral assertions remain attributed and not independently confirmed.

records.title: Judicial-custody review demanded for youth activists
records.summary: Patnaik urged judicial and executive review of the detention of two activists; link to his X post published by The New Indian Express.

records.title: Kotia delegation approved
records.summary: Patnaik approved a BJD delegation to meet residents amid Odisha–Andhra Pradesh boundary and local-poll dispute.

records.title: Disaster-response model questioned
records.summary: Patnaik argued that Odisha's established disaster-management approach was being weakened; the government stated its own preparedness commitments.

records.title: Urgent relief sought after Kandhamal landslides
records.summary: Patnaik called for rescue and relief following reported landslide deaths; a journalist embedded his X post.

records.title: Urban roads, drainage and vending review
records.summary: Soren directed officials to address potholes, drainage and vendor accommodation in an urban-development review.

records.title: Godda welfare-access complaint referred to DC
records.summary: Responding to a public report, Soren instructed the district commissioner to assess welfare eligibility and take action.

records.title: ED-linked land case enters trial stage
records.summary: Court record reporting describes framing of charges in a land-related case; this is not a conviction and Soren has contested allegations.

records.title: Probe ordered after Adivasi woman's custody allegations
records.summary: Soren directed officials to investigate allegations by a tribal woman; two police staff were reportedly suspended. Allegations remain under inquiry.

records.title: Cabinet agenda announced
records.summary: Jagran reported a cabinet meeting chaired by Soren was scheduled for 27 October. This report by itself does not verify decisions taken.

records.title: Delayed JUIDCO recruitment referred for action
records.summary: The CM secretariat directed departmental consideration of a long-running recruitment complaint; completion of recruitment was not established.

records.title: RIMS acting director service extended
records.summary: A health-department notification following Soren's approval extended the tenure of the institute's acting director.

records.title: RINPAS director appointment rules challenged
records.summary: Marandi wrote to Soren questioning compliance of a health-institute recruitment advertisement with regulatory eligibility rules.

records.title: Inquiry requested over DIG-related public-access dispute
records.summary: Marandi wrote to Soren seeking a high-level inquiry over allegations of harassment of a journalist's relatives; claims not adjudicated.

records.title: State-government development record criticised
records.summary: In a Deoghar visit Marandi criticised welfare-service and law-and-order performance; allegations attributed.

records.title: Pending social-pension payments raised
records.summary: Residents complained to Marandi about unpaid old-age and widow pensions; he reportedly warned of a protest.

records.title: Vijayadashami festival greeting
records.summary: A published news page embeds Marandi's X post conveying Vijayadashami wishes.

records.title: Snakebite-patient care at Manika CHC questioned
records.summary: Marandi called for action over alleged denial of care and poor treatment at a health centre; subsequent newspaper report describes contract action.

records.title: Inquiry requested into Jamtara couple deaths
records.summary: Marandi raised suspicions regarding two deaths and requested further investigation; an honour-killing hypothesis is unproven.

records.title: Letter about JUIDCO recruitment delays
records.summary: A local report says Marandi also wrote to officials concerning delayed engineer recruitment; no result is assumed.

records.title: Electric-bus launch and urban transport expansion
records.summary: Majhi inaugurated 26 electric bus services at the National Urban Conclave; 400 additional buses and expansion to nine towns were presented as plans, not completed deployments.

records.title: ST recognition sought for 169 communities
records.summary: Patnaik reiterated the BJD demand for Scheduled Tribe recognition for 169 communities and discussed tribal cultural rights and councils; demand remains subject to applicable central decisions.

records.title: Sand mining approvals and delayed Ranchi works questioned
records.summary: Marandi claimed 288 of 302 auctioned sand ghats remained closed and raised questions about environmental/Gram Sabha clearances, local taxes and road projects; claims are attributed, not independently verified.

records.title: Youth conclave involving students and startups announced
records.summary: Raj Express previewed a state youth conclave scheduled for 6 October and intended CM engagement with young people; scheduling is not confirmation of attendance or results.

records.title: 954 compassionate appointment letters distributed
records.summary: Raj Express reported Yadav distributed 954 compassionate appointment letters and announced construction and school recruitment proposals; proposed buildings and posts are not completed outcomes.

records.title: Tendu-leaf gatherers' bonus distribution announced
records.summary: Raj Express previewed an intended Shahdol visit and tendu-leaf bonus distribution benefiting multiple districts, with associated development works; the article itself is a preview, not verification of transfers.

records.title: Cheetah reintroduction event planned in Sagar
records.summary: Raj Express reported preparations for a cheetah release expected on 7 October in the Veerangana Durgavati Tiger Reserve. This source does not establish release occurred.

records.title: Indore semiconductor summit and investment discussions previewed
records.summary: Raj Express described planned summit discussions on semiconductor design, advanced packaging and investment opportunities. Announced events and targets are not realised investments.

records.title: Durga Puja arrangements and environmental precautions
records.summary: Bhaskar Hindi reported Soren's directions to maintain policing, traffic, electricity, sanitation and environmental care during Durga Puja festivities.

records.title: Election Commission criticism exchanged with opposition
records.summary: Mohan Yadav said Congress should introspect rather than question the Election Commission over defeats; his position is reported as a party-political statement.

records.title: Election Commission independence questioned
records.summary: Singhar accused the Election Commission of favouring the BJP and warned about voters' rights. This is an attributed allegation, not established fact.

records.title: Madhya Pradesh cabinet announces welfare, skills and monsoon-response decisions
records.summary: A cabinet meeting chaired by Yadav included proposals on skills, welfare disbursements and administrative reforms; separate implementation data is necessary.

records.title: Balaghat livelihood initiative for former Maoist-affected villages
records.summary: Yadav announced a ₹225 crore development and livelihood effort covering 100 Balaghat villages and linked it to roads, schools, healthcare and work opportunities.

records.title: Land-record certificates distributed in Harda district
records.summary: Yadav attended a Harda event and distributed land-registration certificates under a village ownership programme, while issuing instructions to revenue staff.

records.title: Social-security pensions transferred to beneficiaries
records.summary: Yadav announced a direct transfer of ₹213.41 crore to more than 35.56 lakh pension recipients at a Narsinghpur programme, according to the report.

records.title: Ladli Behna payments and gas subsidy announced from Umaria
records.summary: Ahead of a scheduled 14 October event the paper reported the planned 41st Ladli Behna instalment and gas subsidy; advance story does not verify completed transfer.

records.title: Kosmi tribal families told they can continue farming disputed land
records.summary: A Budhni MLA said Yadav accepted demands after a delegation met the CM; article reports promised housing restoration and an inquiry, not completed outcomes.

records.title: 954 compassionate education-department appointment letters distributed
records.summary: A press report says Yadav issued appointment letters, discussed pending cases and announced plans for further school staffing and construction.

records.title: Dhar–Jhabua micro-lift irrigation project inaugurated
records.summary: The CM inaugurated a ₹2,387.60 crore scheme intended to irrigate 57,422 hectares in 260 villages; benefits and farmer incomes are projections.

records.title: MP cabinet addresses CAMPA funding and school administration
records.summary: A meeting chaired by Yadav approved ₹2,050 crore in CAMPA-related spending and district education offices, among other decisions; paper lists the announced measures.

records.title: Singhar criticised proposed changes to RGPV university identity
records.summary: Free Press Journal reported a 2 September post from Singhar criticising a plan to reorganise Rajiv Gandhi Proudyogiki Vishwavidyalaya and remove Rajiv Gandhi's name.

records.title: Singhar sought accountability after Sagar liquor-related deaths
records.summary: The leader of opposition criticised the government's response to reported deaths linked to suspected illicit liquor; investigation and attribution remain necessary.

records.title: Singhar raised questions about an EVM replacement in Susner
records.summary: Raj Express included Singhar's allegation concerning a voting machine replacement and his demand for action; the allegation is not independently proven.

records.title: Singhar demanded the chief election commissioner's resignation
records.summary: He addressed a press conference on the Election Commission and voting rights; political allegations remain attributed to him.

records.title: Singhar alleged inflated MLA-fund purchase rates
records.summary: The LoP alleged irregular prices for water tankers and questioned the official procurement schedule; the claims are not findings of proven corruption.

records.title: Singhar cited environmental risks of proposed Rewa nuclear plant
records.summary: After visiting protesting villagers he pledged to raise safety and consultation concerns in the Assembly; the article reports a proposed, not commissioned, plant.

records.title: Singhar visited families after suspicious deaths in Dewas villages
records.summary: He requested ₹25 lakh compensation per affected family and raised alleged illicit-liquor issues. Reported cause of deaths remained subject to inquiry.

records.title: Singhar reacted to Supreme Court direction on anti-defection decision
records.summary: The Supreme Court reportedly directed the Assembly Speaker to decide a disqualification petition within two months; Singhar welcomed the development.

records.title: Singhar raised sanitation workers' safety and regularisation demands
records.summary: Raj Express documented his criticism of sanitation working conditions and pending job-security issues amid labour action; worker-death figures remain attributed.

records.title: Rs 560 crore announced for 28 new urban local bodies
records.summary: At Local Self-Government Day Majhi announced a ₹560 crore package for 28 new NACs and launched urban-project works. Allocations and completed projects should be separated.

records.title: Majhi pledged to fill 45,000 teaching posts over three years
records.summary: At Teachers' Day the CM stated a recruitment target and described the state's free-education policy; the projected positions are not completed appointments.

records.title: CM promoted semiconductor investments and proposed Cuttack hub
records.summary: At SEMICON India 2026 Majhi discussed proposals worth about ₹23,600 crore and potential jobs; these are proposals, not operational fabrication plants.

records.title: Majhi announced awards for women's hockey medal winners
records.summary: The CM announced state cash awards to players and support staff after the 2026 Asian Games; the social announcement was also shared by CMO Odisha.

records.title: Kalinga Studio redevelopment inaugurated
records.summary: Majhi inaugurated the redeveloped Bhubaneswar film studio; the paper reports ₹164 crore sanctioned and a future state film-sector policy plan.

records.title: Odisha created commission on SEBC representation
records.summary: The government notified a commission to study SEBC representation in local self-government after a decision by Majhi.

records.title: Municipal ground rent waived for public puja committees
records.summary: Majhi's decision waived ground rent for Durga, Lakshmi and Kali puja organisers in the BMC area for the specified festive period.

records.title: Puri heritage and tourism works reviewed by Majhi
records.summary: The CM directed faster completion of projects and emphasised protection of Jagannath traditions and temple servitors' welfare during Puri project reviews.

records.title: Free secondary textbooks and skills programme cleared
records.summary: The Majhi-chaired cabinet approved free textbooks for classes IX–X in government and aided schools and a ₹450 crore skills scheme.

records.title: Odisha CM inaugurated 1,608 affordable housing units
records.summary: Majhi inaugurated two Bhubaneswar projects and initiated a rental-housing scheme; the 1,608 homes are delivered units, other housing figures are plans.

records.title: Patnaik demanded CEC resignation amid SIR concerns
records.summary: The opposition leader asked for a review of electoral-roll revision and called for the chief election commissioner's resignation, expressing concerns rather than established wrongdoing.

records.title: Patnaik criticised mining-tax amendments at BJD march
records.summary: Launching the outreach march, Patnaik argued MMDR amendments would restrict Odisha's authority over mineral-bearing land; BJP representatives disputed his arguments.

records.title: Patnaik criticised an attack on a former BJD legislator
records.summary: In an X statement reported by The New Indian Express he questioned law enforcement after an attack on former MLA Pranab Balabantray.

records.title: BJD MPs joined electoral-roll protest at Patnaik's direction
records.summary: The paper reports BJD participation in a New Delhi protest over SIR and election administration; quoted allegations remain attributed.

records.title: Patnaik criticised the state government's record during BJD outreach
records.summary: At a Jana Sampark gathering Patnaik alleged deteriorating governance and questioned development claims; his assessment was contested by the government.

records.title: Patnaik raised prices, welfare and youth opportunities
records.summary: Addressing party workers, Patnaik claimed price increases and government decisions were affecting farmers, women and students; the claims are attributed.

records.title: Patnaik claimed BCJD election results at colleges and universities
records.summary: He claimed BCJD won about half of university positions and 60% of college seats while alleging unfair practices; figures and allegations were not independently certified by this report.

records.title: Patnaik wrote to CM over Kotia border-village dispute
records.summary: The LoP sought the CM's intervention regarding Kotia and backed a delegation to collect local concerns amid an Odisha–Andhra administrative dispute.

records.title: Patnaik contacted Ganjam collector after severe-weather flooding
records.summary: Patnaik contacted the district collector and formed a fact-finding delegation; BJD leaders separately alleged shortcomings in flood preparedness.

records.title: Patnaik-chaired BJD legislative meeting prioritised mining law
records.summary: At a meeting chaired by Patnaik, the party decided to raise the MMDR amendment, textbook errors and farmers' issues during the Assembly session.

records.title: Jharkhand government presented Rs 8,399 crore supplementary budget
records.summary: The Soren-led government tabled a supplementary budget for 2026–27 as the Assembly session began; it should not be confused with expenditure already made.

records.title: Soren promised action over recruitment exam complaints
records.summary: At an Adivasi Day gathering, Soren addressed JPSC-JSSC protest claims and said students would get justice; the allegations require investigation.

records.title: Statue of Ramdas Soren scheduled for unveiling
records.summary: Prabhat Khabar previewed a Jamshedpur ceremony the CM was expected to attend on 15 August; the pre-event report does not establish that he attended.

records.title: Student organisations continued exam reform protest despite CM assurances
records.summary: A reported assurance about fair recruitment examinations did not resolve students' five demands, according to protest coverage.

records.title: High Court rejected Soren plea concerning land-purchase case
records.summary: Hindustan reported a procedural High Court decision regarding a pending case; it is not a conviction or proof of the underlying allegation.

records.title: Soren paid tribute on Gandhi Jayanti in Ranchi
records.summary: The governor and CM visited Bapu Vatika; this is a ceremonial political/public-life record, not a governance outcome.

records.title: University service commission still pending after CM direction
records.summary: Prabhat Khabar reported that the university recruitment commission remained unformed despite an earlier direction by Soren, affecting roughly 6,000 posts.

records.title: Marandi visited hospitalised exam-reform protesters
records.summary: Marandi visited injured or unwell recruitment-exam protesters in Ranchi Sadar Hospital and publicly expressed support, according to a dated Prabhat Khabar article.

records.title: Marandi questioned quality of DMFT-funded road in Pakur
records.summary: He sought inquiry into deteriorating road and retaining-wall works financed through district mineral funding; findings were not yet established.

records.title: Marandi urged talks with students protesting JPSC/JSSC examination process
records.summary: The opposition leader called for government dialogue with protesting students and sought resolution of exam-related demands.

records.title: Marandi again sought investigation of Pakur public works
records.summary: He wrote to the deputy commissioner concerning allegedly deficient road and retaining-wall construction and exclusion from an inquiry.

records.title: Marandi raised allegations over student protest clashes
records.summary: Citing an alleged WhatsApp group message, Marandi questioned whether political workers were organised against protesters. Claims are not independently established.

records.title: Marandi accompanied JPSC student filing police complaint
records.summary: Prabhat Khabar reported Marandi present with a student who filed an FIR alleging harassment by named individuals; allegations await investigation.

records.title: Marandi called for examination committee changes and action
records.summary: He wrote to Soren questioning JSSC exam reform committee appointments and sought investigation and arrests; allegations remain attributed.

records.title: Marandi criticised Congress protest timing and historical conduct
records.summary: Dainik Jagran reported Marandi's political allegations about Congress activity around the festival period; it does not establish the truth of his claims.

records.title: Singhar advocates a separate code to recognise tribal identity
records.summary: At a Bhopal event on International Day of the World's Indigenous Peoples, Singhar demanded a separate code for tribal communities, linking it to constitutional and cultural rights.

records.title: Singhar questions action against Barela tribal families in Kosmi
records.summary: The Indian Express reported Singhar's claim that tribal families faced the consequences of tensions within the governing BJP after officials demolished homes. His interpretation is attributed, not established.

records.title: Kosmi forest-department demolitions prompt public intervention
records.summary: The Indian Express documented the state forest department's demolition of homes of Barela tribal families and criticism by Union Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan, who said he would inform Mohan Yadav; this is not proof of a personal CM demolition order.

records.title: Yadav outlines youth employment, higher education and medical-college proposals
records.summary: At the CM Youth Conclave he announced 2027 as a Year of Youth, plans for 12 medical colleges and 12 universities, two MPPSC exams annually and expanded skills programmes. Plans are not completed institutions.

records.title: MP interns' stipend increase ends Bhopal medical protest
records.summary: After doctors' protests and allegations of police force, the government announced a 50% increase to the internship stipend and an inquiry; the Deputy CM attributed the stipend decision to Mohan Yadav.

records.title: Singhar criticises MP government's defence of OBC quota law
records.summary: After the Madhya Pradesh High Court struck down the 27% OBC reservation law, Singhar and other Congress leaders questioned the government's legal defence and pledged Supreme Court challenge; their criticism is attributed.

records.title: Odisha Cabinet approves Kataka Mahanadi riverfront project
records.summary: A cabinet chaired by Majhi approved the EPC bidding outcome for an estimated ₹133.72 crore riverfront project; construction was expected to begin in November 2026, so it was not a completed work within this window.

records.title: Soren objects to proposed central mining law changes
records.summary: Soren demanded withdrawal of amended mining legislation and warned of a mass agitation; projected revenue effects and interpretations of the law require independent verification.

records.title: Marandi demands filling vacant chief information commissioner post
records.summary: He wrote to Hemant Soren expressing concern over the delayed appointment of Jharkhand's chief information commissioner and asked for swift completion of the selection process.

records.title: Mica-scrap workers petition Marandi about livelihood rules
records.summary: A Koderma-Giridih mica workers' delegation submitted a memorandum to Marandi raising employment risks associated with a customs-office order; no action outcome is established by the article.

records.title: Marandi describes BJP's democracy campaign in Hazaribagh
records.summary: At a press conference, Marandi described a party outreach campaign and made allegations against Congress over public institutions; his allegations remain attributed.

records.title: Recruitment protesters call for Soren's resignation
records.summary: Hindustan reported students' demands relating to JPSC/JSSC examinations and criticism directed at the chief minister. These are protesters' statements, not remarks made by Soren.

records.title: Jharkhand students announce CM-house protest over alleged examination irregularities
records.summary: Hindustan reported planned student protests against recruitment examination management and demands for accountability from Soren; announcement does not verify that the later march occurred.

records.title: Marandi asks state to investigate 108 ambulance procurement
records.summary: Marandi reportedly wrote to the health secretary alleging financial irregularities in the 108 emergency ambulance procurement or operation programme; claims remain unproven.

records.title: Eight Odisha departments had not submitted compliance reports on CM notesheets
records.summary: Dharitri reported that eight departments had not submitted compliance reports on Chief Minister Mohan Charan Majhi's directions, despite monthly chief-secretary reminders. The article distinguishes reported administrative follow-through from the instructions themselves.

records.title: Majhi discusses possible negotiated resolution of Mahanadi water dispute
records.summary: Dharitri reported Majhi had suggested that residents might receive news on resolving the Odisha-Chhattisgarh Mahanadi dispute before Diwali; the article did not establish that a settlement had been reached.

records.title: Dharitri questions progress of previously announced second Odisha AIIMS
records.summary: The Odia newspaper described an RTI-based inquiry into the status of the second AIIMS proposed for Sambalpur, referencing Majhi's 2024 announcement; the 2026 report is about implementation status, not a new 2026 promise.

records.title: Dharitri independently reports BMC festival ground-rent waiver
records.summary: The Odia-language report says the Odisha government waived municipal ground rent for Durga, Lakshmi and Kali Puja events in Bhubaneswar during the stated festival period; this independently covers an announcement also reported elsewhere.

records.title: Majhi releases CM-KISAN instalment and outlines flood assistance
records.summary: The New Indian Express reported the CM-KISAN fifth instalment of ₹833 crore to about 41.35 lakh small or marginal farmers and 13,949 landless agricultural households. The CM also announced a ₹1,000 crore flood-loss assistance package, conditional on damage assessment.

records.title: OrissaPOST reports ₹833 crore farm-assistance transfer
records.summary: OrissaPOST reported the latest direct benefit transfer under CM-KISAN for small and marginal farming households, including PVTGs; CM claims about other outcomes remain separate from the reported transfer.

records.title: Mohan Yadav approves MP Mineral Exploration Policy 2026
records.summary: The Times of India reported that Yadav approved a state policy targeting greater mineral revenue and directing district mineral funding toward welfare and environmental measures; the ₹30,000 crore target is for 2030–31, not achieved revenue.

records.title: Soren cabinet plans Assembly sittings on mineral cess and MMDR law
records.summary: A cabinet chaired by Soren approved plans for two special Assembly sittings in November to discuss mineral cess, the MMDR amendments and electoral-roll revision. The article records the decision, not the outcome of future sittings.

records.title: Hindustan Times examines mining amendments and Soren's protest warning
records.summary: The newspaper reported the passage of central mining-law amendments and Soren's opposition to restrictions on state taxation rights; anticipated fiscal impacts are disputed claims, not confirmed losses.

records.title: Odisha court dismisses revision petition against Patnaik in helicopter-expense case
records.summary: ThePrint's PTI report says a Khurda court dismissed a revision petition alleging misuse of public funds through helicopter travel, finding insufficient substantiation and procedural defects; no wrongdoing was established in that proceeding.

records.title: Ken–Betwa activist ends prolonged protest after Singhar's assurance
records.summary: PTI reported an activist ended a 27-day protest after Singhar visited Panna and pledged support for project-affected tribal farmers demanding rehabilitation, fair compensation and respect for forest rights.

records.title: BJD announces economic blockade over amended MMDR Act; Majhi letter disputed
records.summary: PTI reported BJD's stated intention to escalate opposition to the amended mining law; party spokespeople criticised Majhi for not responding to Naveen Patnaik's letter, while BJP representatives rejected the alleged fiscal interpretation.

records.title: BJD says Patnaik will attend protest against mining amendment
records.summary: At a press conference the party announced that Naveen Patnaik would participate in a 28 September mining-law rally; this report alone does not establish later attendance.

records.title: Mohan Yadav discusses Ladli Behna at NDTV Bhopal conclave
records.summary: NDTV MPCG video of Mohan Yadav discussing the Ladli Behna welfare scheme and responding to Congress criticism. The original broadcaster video is linked.

records.title: Ujjain road-widening and Singhasth project: Mohan Yadav statement
records.summary: NDTV MPCG video about the Ujjain infrastructure works ahead of Singhasth 2028 and the political message concerning the CM's family property.

records.title: Umang Singhar writes to Governor and CM on 27% OBC reservation
records.summary: Bansal News reports Singhar's letter requesting steps to secure legal protections and consideration of Ninth Schedule options for the 27% OBC quota.

records.title: Umang Singhar comments on Bhopal teachers' appointment protest
records.summary: Bansal News covers protesting teaching candidates and quotes Singhar's published X criticism of the state government's handling of the protesters.

records.title: Majhi addresses Gen Z and social-media influences during Har Ghar Tiranga
records.summary: Odisha TV reports the chief minister's comments on misinformation, youth and unity at the campaign event.

records.title: Odisha CM directs health department to reduce maternal and infant mortality
records.summary: Headline found in the OTV topical index; article-level content is not established from this link.

records.title: Majhi reviews cyclone preparedness; 302 response teams mobilised
records.summary: Odisha TV reports the CM's 24 October review of disaster readiness, including 302 response teams and temporary school closures. The zero-casualty objective was a stated goal.

records.title: Naveen Patnaik demands review of electoral-roll revision process
records.summary: Odisha TV reports Patnaik's call for the chief election commissioner's resignation and for a review of the SIR exercise, while noting the commission's response.

records.title: Naveen Patnaik shares Nuakhai festival greeting
records.summary: Odisha TV quoted Patnaik's Nuakhai greeting originally shared on X in the cultural/festival context.

records.title: Hemant Soren announces cancellation and review of recruitment examinations
records.summary: NDTV reports Soren's decision to cancel examinations linked to an external processing agency, examine irregularities going back to 2014 and constitute a reform committee. Later court developments are distinct.

records.title: Jharkhand High Court stays parts of recruitment-exam cancellation
records.summary: NDTV's dated video reports the court's stay of state cancellation orders following candidate challenges; it should not be described as a general conclusion on exam validity.

records.title: Already-appointed Jharkhand candidates protest job losses after cancellation
records.summary: NDTV interviews affected candidates following the Soren cabinet's exam-cancellation decision; this is reporting about policy impacts and affected people's responses.

records.title: Umang Singhar questions farmer payments, procurement and MSP implementation
records.summary: MP Breaking News reported Singhar's statement questioning delays in crop procurement, insurance and farmer payments. His criticism is an attributed political statement, not a verified audit of the programmes.

records.title: Umang Singhar raises environmental and village-consent concerns over Rewa nuclear project
records.summary: MP Breaking News reported Singhar's comments and embedded public X statements concerning a proposed nuclear project, local consent, safety and environmental risks. The project remained proposed.

records.title: Jharkhand students seek independent investigation after state announces exam cancellations
records.summary: NDTV reported that Soren agreed to major recruitment-examination demands but protesting students continued to call for an independent inquiry. This is additional coverage of the same underlying decision.

records.title: Students suspend 26-day Jharkhand recruitment protest with a two-month deadline
records.summary: NDTV's dated protest archive reported the suspension of a 26-day student agitation after the Soren government's examination decision, with further demands outstanding.
